notes:
CRM notes:
- Customer: QuiverDeck (mid-market product analytics SaaS). Primary want: replace incumbent LLM vendor while lowering per-token cost and keeping prompt parity.
- POC scope: hosted API first (3 intents + doc-search embedding rerank), then lift to Dedicated (predictable throughput).
- Key metrics: target p95 latency < 300ms for chat single-turn, throughput target ~200 QPS across concurrent agents, cost target ~30-40% lower than incumbent.
- Migration approach: build a lightweight compatibility shim that maps OpenAI-style calls -> Redwood hosted endpoints; capture prompt templates and tokenize differences.
- Observations: prompt paraphrase caused one billing-intent regression (misclassification -> wrong flow). SE notes: "we captured model output deltas, need prompt engineering + eval harness to gate rollouts".
- Ops/security: need SSO/SAML for prod, KMS integration for embedding encryption, retention policy 90 days for model inputs, EU data residency for EU customers.
- Procurement: legal prefers 3-month Dedicated pilot with opt-in expansion. Finance asks for committed concurrency numbers for pricing.
- Quote: estimated ARR 75k-200k depending on commit level and add-ons (observability retention).
- Conversation tone: pragmatic, engineering-led; CTO quote: "We need parity on our top 20 intents before we flip traffic."
- Suggested Redwood play: offer a dedicated pilot SKU, include prompt-parity regression support and eval suite access, provide a short checklist for security signoff.
- Stubs: drive deck + security answers uploaded; tickets opened for infra sizing and KMS proof-of-concept.
